summary: The distributor asked to pay a refund may never have collected the deposit on that bottle.
realLife: As water entered Oregon’s system, distributors without exclusive territories faced mismatched collections and refunds and joined a statewide cooperative.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: distributor sales territory and settlement records.

turns.what: The cooperative reconciles claims from outside the original sales territory.
turns.pulledBy: A water sale and its redemption occur in different service areas.
turns.writesBack: The clearing record associates the payment with the right parties.

turns.what: After repeal, distributors reconcile the remaining claims through the last payable date.
turns.pulledBy: A statutory claim window survives the last day of new deposits.
turns.writesBack: The cooperative closes the settlement after the last payable claim.
